[ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) as a type of neural network designed for image processing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Key components of CNNs include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Convolutional Layers: Apply filters to detect local patterns.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Activation Functions: ReLU is commonly used for non-linearity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Pooling Layers: Downsample feature maps to reduce dimensions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Flatten Layer: Converts output to a 1D feature vector.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Dense Layers: Fully connected layers leading to output probabilities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Described the process of CNNs for image classification, including image preprocessing, feature extraction, and training.
